denominators.effects: Within matched world/policy/repetition cells, then equal base-cluster means. Family/change-stratified percentile bootstrap; small/degenerate intervals are not evidence of robustness.
denominators.critical_retention: Unique mandatory Boolean scopes whose isolated truth-value flip changes the full-information decision; includes failed summaries as losses.
denominators.necessary_retention: Unique scopes, including objectives, whose removal from full information makes the candidate choice underdetermined. Added exploratory distinction after the initial Boolean-only diagnostic, before new experiments.
denominators.root_error_despite_sufficient_visible_tr: All trajectories; summary values alone imply exactly the oracle choice. This is an observable integration diagnostic, not faithful internal reasoning.
denominators.confidence: Only matched cells with unchanged choice and two valid probability distributions; descriptive conditioning, not causal reliability.

trace_selection_rule: Within each mutation family: maximum and minimum base-average accuracy change; one hash-selected base with zero changes in all cells if available. Extrema can equal zero; flags identify actual improvements/deteriorations.
cautions: All repeated primary reports are correct by construction; no pilot evidence about false-report repetition.
Counterfactual criticality is evaluator-only and does not establish causal mediation.
Ordering and branch assignment are frozen, not randomized independently of repetition; later controls are needed.
